authority: CEO R335-B — experiment-specific EIG. No more identical priors/costs for all candidates.
problem: R333 used identical priors (0.5/0.5), identical likelihoods (0.9/0.1), identical cost ($7500), identical time (4 weeks), identical risk (1.0) for every candidate. This means EIG cannot discriminate between experiments — the selection is arbitrary.
fix: Each candidate experiment carries its own hypothesis space, priors, likelihoods, cost, time, and risk based on its actual scientific uncertainty and commercial burden.

P01-EXP-001.rationale: R318 svMultiPhysics shows 16% agreement (strong prior for advantage). But flow-rate proxy, not true multi-segment mesh. Moderate uncertainty. Higher cost (3-6 month bench build). Higher risk (hardware complexity).

P02-EXP-001.rationale: 47.3% is entirely MODELLED. No external verification. 50/50 prior. Moderate cost, short timeline, low risk (simple bench).

P04-EXP-001.rationale: Enzyme kinetics in CSF unknown. 4/8 biology blocked. Prior leans negative (0.4/0.6). Higher cost, moderate time, moderate risk (biological uncertainty).

P10-EXP-001.rationale: 0.34s predicted from 15x ΔT speedup. Strong prior (0.7). BUT: repair budget exhausted — if FAIL, CEMETERY. High risk (terminal outcome).

P15-EXP-001.rationale: Published range (5-50 μW) supports 10 μW P50. Prior leans positive (0.6). Low cost, short time, low risk.

P16-EXP-001.rationale: T2-CONFIRMED (PyTissueOptics). 1.0-1.4 mW/cm² verified. Strong prior (0.7). Lowest cost, shortest time, lowest risk. Best EIG/cost candidate.

P20-EXP-001.rationale: PLGA kinetics MODELLED from published data. 50/50 prior (no external verification). Moderate cost, long time (30-day incubation), moderate risk.

P21-EXP-001.rationale: Localization MARGINAL (10mm vs 5mm). Prior leans negative (0.3/0.7). Higher cost, longer time, higher risk (phantom fabrication + UWB hardware).

P22-EXP-001.rationale: 4 unresolved control issues (buckling, delay, tissue safety, failure recovery). Prior strongly negative (0.2/0.8). High cost, long time, VERY high risk (could kill architecture).

note: P-07, P-11, P-12, P-13 use default 0.5/0.5 priors with moderate costs. These have less scientific basis for strong priors. The experiment-specific EIG ensures the machine prefers: (1) high-information experiments (uncertain outcome), (2) low-cost experiments, (3) short-timeline experiments, (4) low-risk experiments. P-16 should win on EIG/cost (strong prior, low cost, short time, low risk). P-22 should lose (negative prior, high cost, long time, high risk).
